facts.fact: Baymard Institute found an average of 11.3 fields across 5.1 steps in checkout flows in 2024 (third-party benchmark).
facts.quote: found an average of **11.3 fields across 5.1 steps** in 2024 and estimated that most sites could reduce displayed fields

facts.fact: Baymard Institute estimated that most checkout sites could reduce displayed fields by approximately 20 to 60% without losing essential purchase information (third-party estimate).
facts.quote: estimated that most sites could reduce displayed fields by approximately **20 to 60%** without losing essential purchase information

facts.fact: The vendor recommends running a form A/B test for at least a full business cycle, usually a week or more, including weekday and weekend traffic.
facts.unit: week or more (at least one full cycle)
facts.quote: Plan for at least a full cycle, usually a week or more, including weekday and weekend traffic.

facts.fact: The vendor defines the primary metric for form optimization tests as completed submissions divided by form views.
facts.quote: Calculate completed submissions divided by form views. Count a submission only after the system accepts it.

facts.fact: The vendor defines qualified-lead rate as sales-accepted leads divided by completed submissions.
facts.quote: Define qualified-lead rate as sales-accepted leads divided by completed submissions.

facts.fact: The vendor's practical rule is to remove a form field only when a test shows the qualified-lead rate holds.
facts.quote: Remove a field only when a test shows that the qualified-lead rate holds.

facts.fact: As a starting design, the vendor suggests asking three or four essential questions on the first form submission and collecting deferred details on a confirmation page or follow-up email.
facts.quote: As a starting design, try three or four essential questions for the first submission, then collect deferred details on a confirmation page or follow-up email.

facts.fact: The vendor's guidance says a test variant should be adopted only when the primary metric improves and the quality guardrail holds.
facts.quote: **Adopt when the primary metric improves and quality holds.**

facts.fact: The vendor article was published on 2026-10-26.
pdfFiller's compilation of Shopify checkout figures reports desktop form/checkout completion at 39.1%.
facts.quote: put completion at **39.1% on desktop versus 37.9% on mobile**

facts.fact: The article's validation table recommends validating email fields on blur.
facts.quote: | Email | On blur | Name the missing part and show an example | Rejecting valid plus-addressing |

facts.fact: The article's validation table recommends validating phone fields on blur.
facts.quote: | Phone | On blur | Ask for the number with area or country code | Blocking international formats and spaces |

facts.fact: The article's validation table recommends validating password fields as the visitor types and showing rules before entry.
facts.quote: | Password | As the visitor types | Show the rules before typing | Hiding requirements until submit |

facts.fact: The article's validation table recommends validating free-text fields on submit only.
facts.quote: | Free text | On submit only | Keep text and show the character limit | Clearing the box after an error |

facts.fact: Google's mobile-site performance analysis (a third-party source) found that bounce probability increased 123% as load time rose from one second to ten.
facts.quote: found that bounce probability increased **123%** as load time rose from one second to ten

facts.fact: Google's mobile-site performance analysis (a third-party source) found that conversion probability fell 95% as page elements increased from 400 to 6,000.
facts.quote: conversion probability fell **95%** as page elements increased from 400 to 6,000

facts.fact: Adwave suggests reserving a planning window of two to four weeks for a form test, with the calculated sample requirement and business cycle determining whether that is sufficient.
facts.quote: As a practical planning window, reserve two to four weeks, then let the calculated sample requirement and business cycle determine whether that’s sufficient.
